>
> @sylvain-h: since you've expressed interest in this issue and asked for an ETA, can you confirm your use case involves [searching for facet values](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/393765/44665394-169a1800-aa16-11e8-8978-6328695e8ebf.gif), (not [searching for hits](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2982512/53161552-7d198080-35ca-11e9-9d5a-7a62e0e557c7.gif)).

Initially my request was when searching for hits. It's when you change the input from the main search box that it breaks the refinementList.
